mechanism: Disulfiram inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, reducing lorazepam metabolism and increasing CNS depression risk; disulfiram may also potentiate benzodiazepine effects through unknown mechanisms.
action: Monitor for increased sedation, cognitive impairment, and psychomotor effects; consider dose reduction of lorazepam or alternative benzodiazepine; counsel on CNS depression and alcohol avoidance.
